Simultaneous ousting is covered in the rulebook.

You're both ousted, but you still get a VP (your predator also gets a
VP).

9.1 Victory Points
...
EXCEPTION: If a player is ousted at the same time that her prey is
ousted, the player gets the victory point but does not gain 6 pool.

and now to actually answer the question (which i only just realised
the rest of this thread so far has not explicitly done yet):

from 6.3.3
Political Action Cards. Each Methuselah may gain one vote by using a
political action card. These cards say "worth 1 vote" to indicate
this. If a political action card was used to call the referendum, that
card provides a vote for the acting vampire's controller. Other
political action cards used for votes are simply burned without regard
to the text on the cards. Each Methuselah can gain no more than 1 vote
from political action cards.

from 6.3.2
Polling. All Methuselahs may now cast any votes they have (see below)
at this time, in any order. They call out their votes freely, and
there is no obligation to vote. Once a vote has been cast, however, it
cannot be changed. The polling stage is completed only when all
Methuselahs are finished voting (if you need a time limit, the players
can agree to wait 15 seconds after the last vote cast to close the
polling stage).
Resolve the referendum. If there are more votes for the referendum
than against, the referendum passes, and the effects of the successful
referendum take place. Otherwise, the referendum fails and has no
effect. Tied referendums fail.

neither part says anything about whether the vote has to be in favour
or against, or even if it has to be cast at all. You just gain 1 for
the PA card used to call the referendum, and then you may cast it
freely, with no obligation to vote.

so yes, the vote can be for or against. it can also be not cast at
all.
